'''Arabia''' was a destination on the [[Hovertrain/Legends|Coruscant train]].

==Behind the scenes==
An [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] list of stops that pops up at the [[Hovertrain/Legends|hover train]] station has Arabia listed, along with [[Burbank/Legends|Burbank]], [[Ulendale/Legends|Ulendale]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. For reasons unknown, the same data screens were also found in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

Arabia is another name for the [[Wikipedia:Arabian Peninsula|Arabian Peninsula]].
